title: Validator vote to delist AI16Z
content: {"blocks":[{"key":"43plu","text":"Hyperliquid validators will vote on whether to delist AI16Z around 8:30 UTC on November 6. AI16Z is being rebranded to ELIZAOS. This permissionless stake-based vote weighting primitive is built natively into HyperCore and technically requires no offchain coordination. If validators vote to delist an asset, the perps will settle to the 1 hour time weighted spot oracle price before delisting, and open orders will be canceled. Close any positions beforehand to avoid automatic settlement. After settlement, no new orders will be accepted.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
